notes.title: Update release
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
The update we announced last week is now live :
[list]
[*]The bug causing the leaderboards to be stucked in the "Loading..." state is fixed
[*]You can now correctly unlock the "Run, Forest, run!" success
[*]You can now correctly unlock the "Hail to the king, baby!" success
[/list]
Happy shooting ;)

notes.title: Improve the fun !
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

It's been a week since Wondershot has been released. We are really happy you enjoy the game.

Next week we will push an update to fix some bugs and problems with the leaderboards. If you find bugs (we work hard to have Wondershot really clean so we hope it would just be a minor one), feel free to tell us and we would fix it as soon as we can.

Wondershot is a cool game to play with your friends and family, gathered in the same room, and it is really great just like it is. 

Still, if we can, we want to keep on improving it and add more content to it.
 
So we want your opinion about what you would want for the game:
- More multiplayer maps?
- New game modes?
- More Challenges?
- More Endless battles?
- Other things?

We really want to improve the game with you all.

Have a nice day, and beware of the portals!
